sentences.text: Kurt Leon Sutter -LRB- born May 5 , 1960 -RRB- is an American screenwriter , director , producer , and actor .	screenwriter	screenwriter	director	film director	producer	television producer	actor	actor

He worked as a producer , writer , and director on The Shield , and appeared on the show as hitman Margos Dezerian .	director	film director	producer	television producer	The Shield	The Shield	Margos Dezerian	Margos Dezerian

Sutter is also the creator of Sons of Anarchy on FX ; he wrote , produced , and directed the series , as well as played incarcerated club member Otto Delaney .	Sons of Anarchy	Sons of Anarchy	FX	FX (TV network)
Sutter spent time with members of an outlaw motorcycle club in Northern California as research for Sons of Anarchy .	Sons of Anarchy	Sons of Anarchy	outlaw motorcycle club	outlaw motorcycle club
